description: This file appears to be the main implementation source file for the WifiManager plugin in a WPEFramework-based project. It defines the WifiManager class, its methods, initialization, deinitialization, event notifications, and method registration for JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: WifiManager
classes.description: The main plugin class implementing Wi-Fi management functionality, including handling Wi-Fi state, scan operations, WPS pairing, SSID management, and event notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WifiManager plugin, setting up dependencies and state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deactivated.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information, currently none.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Returns the quirks for the Wi-Fi device.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi state.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts scanning for Wi-Fi networks.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops scanning for Wi-Fi networks.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Wi-Fi.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process (API v1).

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process (API v2).

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID to the preferred list.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Clears saved SSID.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the paired SSID.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if a device is paired.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Retrieves supported security modes.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for Wi-Fi state changes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Event handler for Wi-Fi related errors.

methods.name: onSSIDsChanged
methods.description: Event handler for SSID list changes.

methods.name: onWifiSignalThresholdChanged
methods.description: Event handler for changes in Wi-Fi signal strength.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Notify event for available SSIDs.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WifiManager.
